parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
地域ID。

> 您可以通过[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-streaming-data-source --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --data-source-name test-kafka --data-source-type kafka --data-source-description test-kafka --db-instance-id CreateExternalDataSource --data-source-config broker_list_:_broker0:9091,broker1:9091_,_topic_:_topic --service-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CreateStreamingDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --DataSourceName 'test-kafka' --DBInstanceId CreateExternalDataSource --DataSourceConfig 'broker_list_:_broker0:9091,broker1:9091_,_topic_:_topic' --DataSourceType kafka --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DataSourceDescription 'test-kafka' --ServiceId 1
